svg.title: Decided: the central circle's purpose
svg.desc: The purpose is that all agents point in the same direction and are healthy: helm.d keeps the direction, holacracy.d the health. Options A, B and C were put and none was chosen as worded.
svg.text: The central circle's purpose: decided
Decided 22 November 2026, about 17:05 UTC.
The purpose
All the agents point in the same direction and are healthy
helm.d: direction
connects the dots; peer of the conductors
holacracy.d: health
keeps the record; the system stays healthy
The options as put (none chosen; his wording replaces A)
A (recommended)
One place for the structure and direction of
Dinis's estate ...
B
Keep the map of Dinis's agents and the
decisions about it.
C
Everything not under a conductor.
Dinis, verbatim (answered 22 Nov 2026 about 17:05 UTC, a voice memo in maestro.d's session):
“I agree with the whole agents point in the same direction and healthy ... that's the helm connected to dots, but also
comes to do with the holacracy thing.”
Speech to text. The reading (the purpose in the box above) is helm.d's; the record is board/team/maestro.d/decisions/2026-11-22-voice-memo-18-answers.md.
Ask id circle-purpose, reserved: no (a PT decision, adopted by helm.d). Frozen when decided. Drawn by studio.d.
